limits.intro: DriveDeck is a web app running inside iOS. These are the things that platform, and the music and map services, do not allow. Each one has a workaround where one exists.

items.title: Steering-wheel buttons
items.body: iOS sends Bluetooth media keys to whichever app owns “Now Playing”. A web app cannot intercept them. In Spotify mode the Spotify app plays the music, DriveDeck only remote-controls it and deliberately stays out of the way, so the buttons keep working natively. In YouTube mode DriveDeck registers the media keys itself, but iOS decides how they behave for a video inside a web page, so they may not always respond.

items.title: Spotify needs Premium and the Spotify app
items.body: Playback control through the Spotify Web API only works for Premium accounts, and only while the Spotify app is running on the iPhone. If it is not, DriveDeck shows an “Open Spotify” prompt and retries the transfer automatically. The Web Playback SDK is not supported on iOS, so DriveDeck cannot play Spotify audio itself. Apps in Spotify's development mode are limited to a handful of users.

items.title: Volume
items.body: Spotify on iPhone does not allow remote volume changes, so the slider is hidden there. Use the car or iPhone volume buttons.

items.title: What iOS web apps cannot do
items.body: No orientation lock (rotate the phone or pick a layout in Settings), no Fullscreen API (the home-screen app already runs without browser bars), no guaranteed audio when the app is in the background or the screen is locked, and no Battery or Vibration API, so haptics and battery features are hidden. DriveDeck keeps the screen awake with the Wake Lock API where iOS allows it.

items.title: Turn-by-turn navigation
items.body: Apple Maps, Google Maps and Waze cannot be embedded in a web app, so DriveDeck hands the destination over to the one you choose and restores the screen when you come back. DriveDeck can also guide you itself with open-source routing (OpenStreetMap data, optional toll and motorway avoidance), but only while it is open on screen: iOS stops GPS for web apps in the background and gives them no live traffic, speed limits or lane guidance. Spoken directions use the iPhone voice and can briefly interrupt Spotify. For long or unfamiliar trips, use a dedicated navigation app.

items.title: YouTube
items.body: Videos play in the official YouTube player, which stays visible and unmodified, and only plays while DriveDeck is open on screen. Audio cannot be extracted or played in the background. By default video is blocked while the car is moving; a passenger can confirm to override it. Search uses a daily API quota, so results are cached.

items.title: Signing in inside the home-screen app
items.body: iOS keeps Safari and the installed app separate, and OAuth pop-ups or redirects inside an installed web app are sometimes blocked or return to the wrong place. If Spotify sign-in does not come back to the app, sign in using Safari, copy the connection code from Settings > Accounts and paste it in the installed app. Google sign-in tokens last about an hour.

items.title: Location, speed and the driving lock
items.body: Speed comes from GPS, which can be late or lost in tunnels and garages. The lock stays on when the signal is missing. The driving lock is a convenience, not a certified safety system, and it cannot tell who is holding the phone: the passenger confirmation relies on your honesty. Never use the touch screen in ways the law of your country forbids while driving.

items.title: Maps and search data
items.body: The default map uses OpenStreetMap data served by VersaTiles (satellite: Esri). Heavy use may need your own tile provider. Search uses Photon or Nominatim; Nominatim does not allow search-as-you-type. Google Maps or Apple MapKit need your own key or token and the traffic layer is only available with them. Only tiles you already viewed are available offline.

items.title: Brands
items.body: DriveDeck is an independent app. It is not affiliated with Apple, Spotify or Google, does not use their logos, and its icons are original. The name CarPlay is not used.

install.installedBody: DriveDeck is running as a home-screen app.
install.iosBody: Open DriveDeck in Safari, then add it to your Home Screen. It runs fullscreen and works offline.
install.otherBody: On iPhone, open this page in Safari to install it. Other browsers can install it from their menu.

steps.title: Open in Safari
steps.body: Installing only works from Safari, not from in-app browsers.

steps.title: Tap Share
steps.body: The square-with-arrow button at the bottom of Safari.

steps.title: Add to Home Screen
steps.body: Scroll down in the share sheet and tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.

steps.title: Open from the Home Screen
steps.body: Always launch DriveDeck from its icon so it runs without browser bars. Allow location “While Using the App”.

tips: Set Auto-Lock to Never while driving (Settings > Display & Brightness), or keep DriveDeck open so it can hold the screen awake.
Turn on Rotation Lock in Control Center if the layout should not flip while the phone is in a mount.
Keep the phone charging and out of direct sun; GPS plus a bright screen runs it hot.
Start Spotify once before you drive so DriveDeck can find the device.

onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.welcomeBody: A glanceable dashboard for your iPhone in the car: maps hand-off, a music remote and big, simple controls.
onboarding.locationBody: DriveDeck uses your location for the map, your speed, the driving lock and local weather. It stays on your device and is never uploaded.
onboarding.accountsBody: Connect Spotify to control the Spotify app, and Google to browse your YouTube playlists. You can do this later in Settings.
onboarding.notConfiguredHint: An account button is greyed out when its Client ID has not been added yet (see the README).
onboarding.skipHint: Spotify needs Premium and the Spotify app.
onboarding.layoutTitle: Where should the side rail go?
onboarding.layoutBody: In landscape the rail holds the clock, Home, your pinned apps and the player. Pick the side that suits your mount.
onboarding.doneBody: Everything can be changed later in Settings. Check Known limitations under About to see what iOS does not allow.

pwa.updateReady: A new version of DriveDeck is ready.
